title: User Agent usage and automatic spending conflict
rule: A User Agent cannot trigger an automatic or manual credit reset or perform any billing action. Only Aira admission may consume credits under an already enabled person-controlled auto reset policy, at most three times per natural week; enabling while exhausted does not itself reset. Remote exhaustion preserves the request and returns reset time, balance and the person-controlled settings link.
alternatives: Leave this decision deferred and block dependent implementation.
